description: This file contains utility functions for managing rebaselines, including applying suggested rebaselines, creating patches, and handling git root detection. It is part of the Playwright test runner infrastructure, specifically for handling snapshot rebaselines.

methods.name: addSuggestedRebaseline
methods.description: Adds a suggested rebaseline replacement at a specific location.

methods.name: applySuggestedRebaselines
methods.description: Applies all suggested rebaselines to source files, creating patches or overwriting files based on configuration.
